pokedexEntries.bk: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

pokedexEntries.wh: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

pokedexEntries.sw: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.

pokedexEntries.sh: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.
